name: Xixia Imperial Tombs
description: At the foot of the Helan Mountains in Ningxia, about 40 km west of Yinchuan, this vast burial ground holds nine imperial mausoleums and hundreds of smaller tombs. It was built by the Tangut rulers of the Xixia Dynasty, which arose in 1038 and fell to Genghis Khan's Mongol army in 1227. Spread across roughly 50 square kilometres, it is a rare window into a Buddhist Silk Road kingdom that is still poorly understood.
